properties.name: selected_index
properties.comment: The selected item (SelectedIndex), or none; a view onto the selection. A write shows the item in the editor, moves the open list's row and raises selected_index_changed, then (drop_down_list) text_changed. An index past the end throws std::out_of_range.
hand: a view onto selected_index_; write_view keeps set_selected_index's order; the table entry stays a registration (-1 for none)

properties.name: text
properties.comment: The field's text (Text): the editor's in the drop_down style, otherwise the selected item's; a view. A write sets the editor's text (the selection follows it), or in the drop_down_list style selects the item equal to it, or none. Invalid UTF-8 throws std::invalid_argument.

table.description: Text of the field: the editor's in the drop_down style, otherwise the selected item's.

hand: a view onto the editor's text or the selected item; write_view keeps set_text's refusal and event order

properties.name: placeholder_text
properties.comment: The hint the field shows while no item is selected and no text is typed; the editor shows it in the drop_down style. Throws std::invalid_argument for invalid UTF-8.

table.description: The hint the field shows while no item is selected and no text is typed.

hand: written passes the hint to the editor

properties.name: dropped_down
properties.comment: Whether the list is open (DroppedDown); a view. Writing true opens it on every item (when attached and not empty), false closes it; either raises drop_down_changed when the state changes.
hand: a view onto dropped_down_; write_view opens or closes the list

properties.name: maximum_drop_down_items
properties.comment: The most rows the open list shows before it scrolls (MaxDropDownItems), 1 to 64 (std::invalid_argument otherwise). An open list reopens at the new height.

properties.name: drop_down_width
properties.comment: The open list's width (DropDownWidth); zero follows the field's width. 0 to 4096 (std::out_of_range otherwise).
prepare: throw std::out_of_range("ComboBox drop-down width must be finite and between 0 and 4096");

properties.name: font
properties.comment: The field's and the list's font (Font). Throws std::invalid_argument for an invalid FontSpec; any write marks the font as set from code.
hand: shared FontCapability<ComboBox>; written passes the font to the editor and the open list

properties.name: drop_down_style
properties.comment: Whether the field takes text (drop_down, a TextBox editor) or shows the selected item (drop_down_list, the default) (DropDownStyle). A change closes the list and creates or removes the editor.

table.description: Whether the field takes text (drop_down) or shows the selected item (drop_down_list).

hand: written closes the list and creates or removes the editor

properties.name: drop_down_filter
properties.comment: Which items a drop_down field's list shows as the user types: every item, those starting with the text, or those containing it. A change closes the list.

table.description: Which items a drop_down field's list shows as the user types.

hand: written closes the list and reconfigures the editor's auto-complete

properties.name: auto_complete_mode
properties.comment: How the drop_down editor offers completions (AutoCompleteMode); a filtered list turns the editor's own completion off.

properties.name: auto_complete_source
properties.comment: Where the editor's completions come from (AutoCompleteSource); list_items offers the items.

properties.name: auto_complete_custom_source
properties.comment: The candidates for AutoCompleteSource::custom_source (AutoCompleteCustomSource). Never null: a new box owns an empty collection; null throws std::invalid_argument.
hand: prepare refuses null; written reconfigures the editor's auto-complete

not_properties.name: items
not_properties.reason: a collection; stays methods (W owns collections)
